## Description

Encode the role-permission matrix (solo doctor, doctor, receptionist, nurse, practice admin, care coordinator, patient; hospital roles later) as capabilities. ASP.NET Core authorization policies check tenant, facility, role/capability, and — as hooks for P2 — care relationship and purpose. Every endpoint must declare a policy; an architecture test fails the build for any endpoint without one. Export the matrix as docs (role matrix is part of the P0 delivery package).

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** Every API endpoint has an explicit authorization policy; an automated test enumerates endpoints and fails if any is anonymous by accident (allow-list for public endpoints).
- [ ] **AC2.** A receptionist calling a clinical-note endpoint gets 403 regardless of UI (security test), and the attempt is audited as "Denied".
- [ ] **AC3.** Capabilities per role match the Foundations matrix cell-by-cell (table-driven test generated from docs/02-design/data/foundations.json).
- [ ] **AC4.** Custom roles can only be composed from existing capabilities; locked capabilities from a built-in role cannot be granted (preparation for F-10).
- [ ] **AC5.** docs/02-design/sitemap-and-permissions.md is the published role matrix and is linked from the R0 release notes.

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../docs/05-delivery/README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
